title: Business managament game. Trailer entirely made with AI!
author: paderon
selftext:
Hello everyone, Im new to this sub but i wanted to share a game i am working on.  
Its a business managament game, heavily inspired by the topsim program at my business course in my university. i liked doing it and decided to make it into a more fun and funny game. 

Basically you all start with the same business and start with the same cash etc. You can choose your quality and can calculate your costs and spendings and then also calculate how much you need to produce etc. 

Once everyone put in their decision the round ends and your headquarters grows or shrinks based on your evaluation.

You can also trade eachothers stock and make under the table deals.

I played it a couple times with some friends and we like playing it. we are business students tho so it is in our niche and this game is definetly not for everyone lol.

Playing with bots is completly free. your first online match is also free. If you want to play more online just send me a DM and i can give you a free code (in return for some feedback :) )

Thats it, thanks everyone
